summary: Restoration pledges create 10,000 ha of forest stands (1,000 ha annually) and support natural regeneration over 20,000 ha (2,000 ha annually), together about 2.2% of current forest area; corresponding carbon-sequestration estimates are -199,561 and -311,771 thousand t CO2e. Conservation has no area target, but forest and biodiversity is assigned 46.15 million 2021 USD. Agriculture expands organic arable land to 76,570 ha in 2030 and 100,000 ha in 2035 (1.7–2.3% of current agricultural area), reduces water-resource losses and use by 10%, and combines 3.5%/7% livestock reductions in 2030/2035 with manure storage for 100,000 cattle and feed additives for 11,500–20,000. Mixed measures cover 56,000 ha of forest management, 1,000 ha of plantations, 30,000 ha of pasture overseeding, 50,000 ha of organic-fertilizer improvement, rotational management on 350,000 ha (4.0% of grassland), and 10,000 ha of orchards; aggregate LULUCF reductions are 203,031–315,241 thousand t CO2e.
